projects.title: FormSpace
projects.description: A Google Forms–style platform built for teams, with a visual workflow layer on top. Users compose multi-section forms from eight question types (text, email, URL, date, MCQ, dropdown, linear scale, file upload) via a drag-and-drop canvas, then wire sections into branching paths that route respondents based on nested AND/OR conditions on their answers. Teams organize forms into workspaces with a six-level role hierarchy, email invites, and per-form sharing; responses can be filtered, analyzed, and exported to Excel, with file uploads handled through presigned S3 URLs.

projects.title: Shadow-Code
projects.description: Java migration intelligence platform — parses repositories, builds dependency graphs, performs risk analysis, and converts source files to Go, Kotlin, or TypeScript via Gemini AI. Features AST parsing, cycle-detecting dependency graphs, a D3.js force-directed risk map, and side-by-side diffs of original vs. AI-converted code.

projects.title: Chapter Recruitment Platform
projects.description: Co-led full-stack development of a multi-domain recruitment system with role-based auth, multi-stage candidate evaluation, and automated interview scheduling across 5 domains. Processed 1,100+ applications end-to-end through a 3-stage pipeline, streamlining chapter intake and increasing membership by 40%.

projects.title: Load & Stability Analyzer
projects.description: Full-stack load testing and API stability analysis tool. Fires concurrent requests at any HTTP endpoint via a Go worker-pool engine with optional ramp-up, then computes a weighted stability score from error rate, P95 latency, and retry amplification, with automatic collapse detection when the system starts to fall over.

projects.title: ComputeHive
projects.description: A self-hosted distributed task runner — users package workloads as Docker images via a Tauri desktop client, which uploads artifacts and submits jobs to a Go coordinator that schedules execution across registered worker nodes. The coordinator persists job and worker state in Redis with per-worker heartbeat monitoring; failed jobs are automatically requeued within 10–13s, and workers pull jobs via gRPC, execute containers, and stream results back.

projects.title: Cryptic Hunt Backend

Structured a normalized PostgreSQL schema and shipped a real-time admin dashboard for live monitoring, processing 70,000+ API requests with zero downtime under sustained load.
